source.title: Alberto Ascari — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson
source.locator: Claim-specific Hall of Fame paragraph or section recorded in each claim.evidence.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 source inspected on 2026-10-24; per-claim locators record relevant sections. Independent publisher corroboration and EN/UK human review pending.

claims.en: Ascari won consecutive Formula 1 Drivers' World Championships in 1952 and 1953 with Ferrari.
claims.uk: Аскарі здобув два поспіль титули чемпіона світу Формули-1 у 1952 та 1953 роках із Ferrari.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Given his family responsibilities': Ferrari titles in 1952 and 1953, six and five wins.
FIA 2016 Italian GP media kit, 'F1 WORLD CHAMPIONS SINCE 1950' table: 1952 and 1953 Alberto Ascari, Ferrari.
Biographical paragraph 'fu campione del mondo nel 1952 e nel 1953' explicitly confirms both titles.

claims.en: Ascari died in a testing accident at Monza on 26 May 1955.
claims.uk: Аскарі загинув під час випробувального заїзду в Монці 26 травня 1955 року.

evidence.locator: Final career paragraphs: Monza Ferrari sports-car test crash on third lap and date May 26, 1955.
Final biographical paragraph: 'Il 26 maggio 1955' and 'provando sulla pista di Monza' describes the fatal testing accident.

claims.en: Ascari won six of the seven championship races he contested in the 1952 season in his Ferrari 500.
claims.uk: У сезоні 1952 року Аскарі виграв шість із семи залікових перегонів, у яких брав участь, за кермом Ferrari 500.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Given his family responsibilities': Ferrari 500 won six of seven 1952 championship races.

claims.en: At the 1955 Monaco Grand Prix, Ascari survived when his Lancia crashed into the harbour.
claims.uk: На Гран-прі Монако 1955 року Аскарі вижив після того, як його Lancia впала в гавань.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Following his runaway championships': Lancia D50 plunged into Monaco harbour and driver survived.
Opening section 'On this week in 1955' identifies the 22 May Monaco Grand Prix, Lancia D50 falling into the harbour and Ascari escaping.

gaps: Validate provisional slug against pinned F1DB.
